words.text: A cliff above a black, restless sea.
Revelio shows what the rock hides.
The way in lies beneath the water.
The arch takes its toll in blood from all who enter.
Revelio again. The chain was always there.
Pull it, and the boat rises to meet you.
Stay in the boat. The lake does not welcome swimmers.
At its heart, the Basin of Despair.
But the lake keeps its own dead.
The dead fear fire and light. Little else.
Remember the way. A map will show you where.
